speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise while pregnant; how many weeks pregnant are you and when did these symptoms begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: The timeline of ice cream consumption three days prior to symptom onset is concerning for Listeria monocytogenes infection, which can cause febrile illness and sepsis in pregnant women. Have you experienced any abdominal pain, diarrhea, or vomiting alongside these systemic symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The combination of maternal fever, headache, anorexia, and recent consumption of unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream) at 30 weeks gestation is highly specific for this condition. Immediate empiric treatment with ampicillin is required.
